description: This Java source file implements a class `CmsStaticContentFileManagerInfinispanImpl` that manages static content files (images, CSS, JS, PDF, etc.) for a CMS, using Infinispan cache as the storage backend. It provides methods for adding, retrieving, listing, and removing static files associated with merchant stores, with cache tree nodes organized by merchant store code and content type.

classes.name: CmsStaticContentFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: Implements file management for static content files using Infinispan cache, supporting addition, retrieval, listing, and deletion of files associated with merchant stores, categorized by content type.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton pattern method to get the current instance.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a static content file for a merchant store, storing the file bytes in Infinispan cache.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a static content file as OutputContentFile based on store, content type, and file name.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all files of a specific static content type for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific file for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Lists the names of all static content files within a given store and content type.
